papers.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
papers.authors: Ahmed Oumar El-Shangiti, Abzal Nurgazy, Hilal AlQuabeh, Nikolai Rozanov, Kentaro Inui
papers.affiliations: MBZUAI; DataBayt.AI Labs; Imperial College London
papers.intro: 本文通过在多模型、多数据集上训练探针分析VLM中间层表征，发现计数错误的根源在于内部正确计数信息与模型输出之间的子空间错位，并基于此提出了一种探测器引导的自校正方法，在不更新参数的情况下将计数准确率提升最多15.6个百分点。

papers.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
papers.authors: Junfei Zhan, Haoxun Shen, Mingang Guo, Zixuan Huang, Tengjiao He
papers.affiliations: University of Pennsylvania; Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Jinan University
papers.intro: 通过首个系统性边缘VLM能耗分析（5个模型、3个架构家族、4种分辨率、2个平台），发现推理平均功率是模型固有常数（变化<5%），每个输出token的成本是每个输入（含视觉）token的11-39倍，解码阶段占总能耗86-97%，视觉token修剪最多节省10%能量，而控制输出长度可节省高达97%，证…

papers.title: What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
papers.authors: Filippo Ziliotto, Luciano Serafini, Lamberto Ballan, Tommaso Campari
papers.affiliations: University of Padova, Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK)
papers.intro: 本文发现冻结的几何基础模型VGGT内部隐式编码了层次化的共视性结构，并提出Co-VGGT——仅训练一个轻量级层感知混合专家头（<7.5M参数），从RGB输入中达到接近人类的共视性预测精度，在Co-VisiON基准上超过此前最佳方法超过25%（成对）和10%（多视图）。

papers.title: HiHR: Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Qiwei Yang, Pingping Zhang
papers.affiliations: Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, China
papers.intro: 本文提出一种名为HiHR的层次双曲表示框架，首次将双曲空间建模引入跨视角行人检索，通过文本引导的多粒度融合与分层双曲学习，同时保持跨视角身份一致性和视角特定判别信息。

papers.title: Event Stream based Multi-Modal Video Anomaly Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Algorithms
papers.authors: Peipei Zhu, Yueqing Niu, Lin Zhu, Guanchong Niu, Yang Yu, Zheng Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: 天津中医药大学中药制药工程学院（Peipei Zhu, Yueqing Niu, Yang Yu, Zheng Li）；北京师范大学人工智能学院（Lin Zhu）；西安电子科技大学广州研究院（Guanchong Niu）；天津中医药大学中药组分国家重点实验室（Zheng Li，兼）
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个真实场景可见光-事件双模态异常检测基准数据集TJUTCM Pha，并设计了统一利用视频、事件流和文本语义的E-VAD多模态异常检测框架，通过跨模态对比预训练和自适应融合显著提升了挑战性条件下的异常检测鲁棒性。

papers.title: Equivariant Filter for High Performance Image Tracking using an Event Camera
papers.authors: Angus Apps, Yixiao Ge, Timothy L. Molloy, Robert Mahony
papers.intro: 本文提出一个级联的等变滤波器（EqF）框架，利用AEB跟踪器提取事件流中的特征位置，并通过等效测量更新解相关时间相关性，实现高达7000像素/秒的高速平面图像跟踪。

papers.title: Wat3R: Underwater 3D Geometry Learning without Annotations
papers.authors: Jiangwei Ren, Xingyu Jiang, Zijie Song, Wei Xu, Hongkai Lin, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 提出Wat3R，一种基于教师-学生半监督学习的跨域自适应框架，仅利用未标注真实水下视频将前馈3D重建模型从陆地迁移到水下场景，无需任何水下3D标注。

papers.title: ZipDepth: Bringing Lightweight Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Anywhere, on Any Device
papers.authors: Fabio Tosi, Luca Bartolomei, Matteo Poggi, Stefano Mattoccia
papers.intro: ZipDepth是一个仅6.1M参数的轻量级单目深度网络，通过从基础模型（Depth Anything v2-Large）进行大规模多域知识蒸馏，结合高效可重参数化编码器-解码器，在多个零样本基准上实现了轻量模型中最佳的精度-效率权衡，接近50倍参数量的基础模型水平，且可在GPU、CPU、嵌入式及手…

papers.title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Cheng-De Fan, Chun-Wei Tuan Mu, Chen-Wei Chang, Chin-Yang Lin, Kun-Ru Wu, Yu-Chee Tseng, Yu-Lun Liu
papers.affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan
papers.intro: LongE2V提出一种基于预训练视频扩散先验的统一框架，通过自回归展开、自适应上下文切换、重编码对齐与交叉残差校正等策略，高效解决事件视频的重建、预测和帧插值任务，在真实数据集上超越现有方法。

papers.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
papers.authors: Hongyu Liu, Chun Wang, Feng Gao, Xuanhua He, Yue Ma, Ziyu Wan, Yong Zhang, Xiaoming Wei, Qifeng Chen
papers.affiliations: Meituan, HKUST, City University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 提出OPSD-V，一种基于策略的自蒸馏范式，通过引入真实长视频作为时间上下文，对已有的少量步自回归视频扩散模型进行后训练，在不改变采样路径和推理机制的前提下，提供密集的去噪级监督，有效减少长范围错误累积并提升运动动态。

papers.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
papers.authors: Xinyan Chen, Ziyu Guo, Renrui Zhang, Dongzhi Jiang, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: Xinyan Chen - ByteDance Seed, CUHK MMLab; Ziyu Guo - CUHK IMIXR; Renrui Zhang - ByteDance Seed; Dongzhi Jiang - ByteDance Seed, CUHK MMLab; Hongsheng Li - CUHK MMLab
papers.intro: 本文通过构建包含11类任务的推理视频数据集OpenCoF-17K，微调Wan2.2-I2V-A14B得到Wan-CoF，并提出视觉和文本推理标记机制，在四个外部视频推理基准上显著提升了CoF推理能力。

papers.title: AUTOPILOT VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Incident-Centric Dashcam Understanding
papers.authors: Siddharth Damodharan, Radhika Gupta, Ali Alshami, Ryan Rabinowitz, Jugal Kalita
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, autonomous driving, video search
papers.affiliations: University of Colorado Colorado Springs, University of Michigan, University of Notre Dame
papers.intro: 本文提出了 AUTOPILOT-VQA，一个以事故为中心的行车记录仪视频 VQA 基准，通过结构化的问答对和 Kaggle 竞赛平台，系统评估视觉语言模型在安全关键驾驶场景中的推理能力，并揭示了当前模型在深度推理上的显著局限。

papers.title: WaspMOT: A Benchmark for Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking of Trichogramma Wasps
papers.authors: Tomasz Stanczyk, Yuan Gao, Hardik Agarwal, Seongroo Yoon, Tiantao Zhang, Vincent Calcagno, Francois Bremond
papers.affiliations: Inria, Sophia Antipolis, France; INRAE Institut Sophia Agrobiotech, Sophia Antipolis, France; Université Côte d’Azur, Sophia Antipolis, France; Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Delhi, India; Institute of Plant Protection, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Beijing, China
papers.intro: 论文提出了WaspMOT——一个用于长期多目标跟踪的基准数据集（赤眼蜂跟踪，每段视频超480秒），并通过oracle检测隔离评估五种跟踪方法，发现所有方法均出现严重轨迹碎片化，而简单空间拼接即可提升性能，揭示了现有方法在长期身份保持上的不足。

papers.title: Pose-to-Biomechanics: Bridging 3D Human Pose Estimation and Biomechanical Attribute Prediction
papers.authors: Ayda Eghbalian, Kevin Desai
papers.affiliations: University of Texas at San Antonio
papers.intro: 本文提出BioModule，一个轻量级的即插即用时间Transformer，可附加在任何3D姿态估计器之后，从标准17关节3D骨架中直接预测运动学、动力学和神经肌肉三类共17种生物力学属性，并通过构造对齐的Human3.6Mplus数据集和跨估计器基准测试验证其有效性。

papers.title: LTM: Large-scale Terrain Model for Wildfire-prone Landscapes
papers.authors: Xiao Fu, Yue Hu, Meida Chen, Peter Anthony Beerel, Barath Raghavan
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多模态重建框架LTM，利用过时的数字高程模型（DEM）作为几何先验，结合物理驱动的像素级图像-DEM对齐，在不依赖昂贵特征匹配的情况下，从稀疏地面图像实现大规模野火易发区域的高保真、实时深度图生成和地形更新。

papers.title: HumanForge: A Human-Centric Deepfake Video Benchmark with Multi-Agent Forgery Rationales
papers.authors: Wenbo Xu, Zhimin Chen, Xiaojie Liang, Hengrui Liu, Wei Lu
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou 510006, China
papers.intro: 本文构建了HumanForge——一个覆盖四种人类中心生成场景、包含超过18,000个合成视频的大规模深度伪造基准，并提出了Gen2Anno多智能体框架，通过对比式推理自动生成细粒度、可解释的伪造注释。

papers.title: Do Egocentric Video-Language Models Capture Both Hand- and Object-Centric Cues?
papers.authors: Masatoshi Tateno, Alexandros Stergiou, Risa Shinoda, Yoichi Sato, Dima Damen
papers.affiliations: The University of Tokyo (Masatoshi Tateno, Risa Shinoda, Yoichi Sato); University of Twente (Alexandros Stergiou); University of Bristol (Dima Damen)
papers.intro: 该论文提出一种结合手-物体掩码训练与HOI动力学感知解码器的训练范式，并构建了可独立评估手/物体线索的CI-HOI评估协议和DEHOI测试台，使现有视频-语言模型更有效地同时捕捉手中心和物体中心信息。

papers.title: MatBind: A Shared Embedding Space for Multimodal Materials Characterization
papers.authors: Le Yang, Anoop K. Chandran, Jona Östreicher, Evgenii Sovetkin, Adrian Mirza, Sebastien Bompas, Bashir Kazimi, Pascal Friederich, Stefan Kesselheim, Kevin Maik Jablonka, Stefan Sandfeld
papers.affiliations: Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH; Karlsruhe Institute of Technology; Helmholtz-Zentrum Berlin; RWTH Aachen University; University of Cologne; Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Helmholtz Institute for Polymers in Energy Applications Jena
papers.intro: MatBind提出一种以晶体结构为中心锚点的对比学习框架，将晶体结构、模拟pXRD、态密度和文本四种材料模态对齐到统一嵌入空间，实现了无需显式配对训练即可进行的零样本跨模态检索，并让嵌入空间自发组织出物理上有意义的属性结构。

papers.title: Selective Timestep Weighting and Advantage-Based Replay for Sample-Efficient Diffusion RLHF
papers.authors: Eric Zhu, Abhinav Shrivastava, Soumik Mukhopadhyay
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Maryland, College Park
papers.intro: 提出每时间步加权和历史硬挖掘重放两种互补策略，在不改变架构的前提下显著提升扩散模型RLHF的样本效率，最多可达6倍。

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Shuailei Ma, Jiaqi Liao, Xinyang Wang, Jingjing Wang, Chaoran Feng, Zijing Hu, Chong Bao, Zichen Xi, Yuqi Gan, Weisen Wang, Yanhong Zeng, Qin Zhao, Zifan Shi, Wei Wu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Shangzhan Zhang, Jiahao Shao, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Lunke Pan, Nan Xue, Kecheng Zheng, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Ka Leong Cheng
papers.intro: LingBot-Video 是一个基于 DiT 的 MoE 视频预训练范式，通过稀疏 MoE 架构、机器人增强数据和多维奖励系统，专为具身智能设计，首次大规模开源了 MoE 视频基础模型。
